## Vergleich Anzahl Daten DxI9000 und DxI800

```{r, startup, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
source("StartUp.R")
StartUpRoutine()
```

```{r, SQL queries, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

n.single.query <- "
                  SELECT
                      (SELECT DISTINCT md.Methode
                      FROM MeasurementData AS md
                      JOIN MethodData AS m ON md.Methode = m.Methode
                      JOIN TranslationData AS t ON md.Methode = t.Methode
                      JOIN DxIvalData AS d ON t.TestOrderCode = d.TestOrderCode
                      WHERE d.TestName = main.TestName AND main.DoseUnit IS NOT NULL
                      LIMIT 1) AS inlab,
                      
                    TestName AS DxI9000,
                    
                    COUNT(*) AS n,
                      
                      
                  (SELECT DISTINCT DoseUnit
                       FROM DxIvalData AS sub
                       WHERE sub.TestName = main.TestName AND sub.DoseUnit IS NOT NULL
                       LIMIT 1) AS Einheit,
                  
                  (SELECT 
                      -- md.Bezeichnung as DxI800,
                      COUNT(*) -- AS n_800
                      FROM MeasurementData AS md
                      JOIN MethodData AS m ON md.Methode = m.Methode
                      JOIN TranslationData AS t ON md.Methode = t.Methode
                      JOIN DxIvalData AS d ON t.TestOrderCode = d.TestOrderCode
                      WHERE d.Probennummer = md.Probennummer AND d.Probennummer IS NOT NULL AND d.TestName = main.TestName
                      ) AS n_800,
                      
                  (SELECT DISTINCT m.EINHEIT
                      FROM MeasurementData AS md
                      JOIN MethodData AS m ON md.Methode = m.Methode
                      JOIN TranslationData AS t ON md.Methode = t.Methode
                      JOIN DxIvalData AS d ON t.TestOrderCode = d.TestOrderCode
                      WHERE d.TestName = main.TestName AND main.DoseUnit IS NOT NULL
                      LIMIT 1) AS Einheit_800
                  
                FROM 
                  DxIvalData AS main
                WHERE
                  DoseResult <> 'No result'
                GROUP BY
                  TestName;"
n.single.dat <- dbGetQuery(con, n.single.query)
  

n.double.query <- "
  SELECT 
    subquery.TestName AS DxI9000,
    -- subquery.Methode,
    -- subquery.TestOrderCode,
    COUNT(*) AS n_Doppel,
    subquery.CurveExpirationDT AS Verfallsdatum
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      a.Werte AS DxI800,
      d.DoseResult_c AS DxI9000,
      a.Bezeichnung,
      a.Methode,
      m.EINHEIT AS Einheit_800,
      d.DoseUnit AS Einheit_9000,
      d.Probennummer,
      d.TestName,
      d.CurveExpirationDT
    FROM MeasurementData a
    JOIN MethodData m ON a.Methode = m.Methode
    JOIN TranslationData t ON a.Methode = t.Methode
    JOIN DxIvalData d ON t.TestOrderCode = d.TestOrderCode
    WHERE a.Probennummer = d.Probennummer 
      AND d.DoseResult <> 'No result'
  ) AS subquery
  GROUP BY subquery.TestName, 
        -- subquery.TestOrderCode, 
           subquery.Methode;
"

n.double.dat <- dbGetQuery(con, n.double.query)
n.double.dat$Verfallsdatum <- as.Date(n.double.dat$Verfallsdatum, format = "%m-%d-%Y")
  


# enable and register the REGEXP function in the SQLite connection
initExtension(con, extension = "regexp")
prc.L1.query <- "SELECT 
                  TestName AS DxI9000,
                  COUNT(*) AS _n_QC_Messungen
                FROM 
                  DxIvalData
                WHERE
                  Probennummer IS NULL 
                  AND SampleID REGEXP '[a-zA-Z]+1' --_\\d'
                  AND DoseResult <> 'No result'
                GROUP BY
                  TestName;"
L1 <- dbGetQuery(con, prc.L1.query)

prc.L2.query <- "SELECT 
                  TestName AS DxI9000,
                  COUNT(*) AS _n_QC_Messungen
                FROM 
                  DxIvalData
                WHERE
                  Probennummer IS NULL 
                  AND SampleID REGEXP '[a-zA-Z]+2' --_\\d'
                  AND DoseResult <> 'No result'
                GROUP BY
                  TestName;"
L2 <- dbGetQuery(con, prc.L2.query)

prc.L3.query <- "SELECT 
                  TestName AS DxI9000,
                  COUNT(*) AS _n_QC_Messungen
                FROM 
                  DxIvalData
                WHERE
                  Probennummer IS NULL 
                  AND SampleID REGEXP '[a-zA-Z]+3' --_\\d'
                  AND DoseResult <> 'No result'
                GROUP BY
                  TestName;"
L3 <- dbGetQuery(con, prc.L3.query)

prc.dat <- data.frame(L1$`_n_QC_Messungen` , 
                 L2$'_n_QC_Messungen' , 
                 L3$'_n_QC_Messungen', 
                 L1$DxI9000)
colnames(prc.dat) <- c("n_L1", "n_L2", "n_L3", "DxI9000")
```

```{r, echo=FALSE}

    sum.dat <- merge(n.single.dat, prc.dat, by = "DxI9000", all = TRUE)
    sum.dat <- merge(sum.dat, n.double.dat, by = "DxI9000", all = TRUE)
    sum.dat[is.na(sum.dat)] <- 0
    
    # Define  color function for dates
date_color <- function(date) {
  days_until_expiry <- as.numeric(date - Sys.Date())
  color <- scales::col_numeric(palette = c("yellow", "green"), domain = c(0, max(days_until_expiry)))(days_until_expiry)
  return(color)
}

date_color <- function(date) {
  days_until_expiry <- as.numeric(date - Sys.Date())
  
  color <- ifelse(
    days_until_expiry < 0, 
    "red",
    ifelse(
      days_until_expiry <= 15, 
      scales::col_numeric(palette = c("yellow", "white"), domain = c(0, 15))(days_until_expiry),
      scales::col_numeric(palette = c("white", "green"), domain = c(16, max(days_until_expiry)))(days_until_expiry)
    )
  )
  return(color)
}
    sum.dat |> 
      flextable() |>  
        theme_vanilla() |>  
        bg(bg = "grey", part = "header") |> 
        align(align = "center", part = "all") |> 
        bg(j = 10, bg = scales::col_numeric(palette = c("red", "yellow", "green"), domain = c(0, 75))) |>
        bg(j = 11, bg = sapply(sum.dat$Verfallsdatum, date_color)) |>
        set_table_properties(width = 0.6, layout = "autofit")
```
